description: Brikk looks mechanically stumped while keeping both feet planted and the wrench lowered securely in one hand. The shoulders rise in a broad shrug, the free hand scratches the head beneath one goggle strap, the mouth opens slightly in surprise, and the goggles tilt unevenly. One small amber puff of steam curls clockwise, changes its mind, curls counter-clockwise, and disappears without forming punctuation or a symbol; no walking, tool trick or distress. The emotion must read immediately as genuinely surprised and thoughtfully confused, never sad, ashamed, angry or mocking.

Brikk keeps the wrench low, slowly turns it to inspect one end, reverses it to inspect the other end, then looks back at the first end with both eyebrows high and mouth gently open. The free hand turns palm-up beside the waist while the two long ears angle in different directions, forming a clear but respectful 'these do not agree' silhouette. No projection, gear, bolt, steam, smoke, liquid, puddle, stain, wet patch, floor mark or scenery appears anywhere.
Preserve the exact approved design, silhouette, pixel-art rendering, proportions, colours, camera angle and these permanent invariants: moss-green skin; exactly two arms, two legs and two pointed ears; two oversized amber goggles; patched teal apron; one dark metal rune wrench.
Keep the full body visible at unchanged scale. Start from the supplied neutral pose and finish settled in that exact pose. VARIANT FIVE ADDITIVE CANDIDATE: This is a new review candidate, not a replacement for earlier takes. Perform only the newly authored character-specific choreography above. Give the clip one dominant readable acting idea, a clean silhouette and clear negative space. Do not fall back to generic head scratching, broad arm waving or any gesture from an earlier take.
